completeDialog.title: Complete Review
completeDialog.description: You are about to mark this transcript review as complete. Here's a summary of the review work.
completeDialog.noEdits: No edits have been made to this transcript yet. Are you sure you want to mark it as complete?

success.title: Review Completed
success.description: The review has been marked as complete.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failed to mark review as complete

followUpFailed.title: Review complete, follow-up failed
followUpFailed.description: The review is complete, but this did not run: {actions}. Start it again from the meeting admin panel.

errors.stats: The review statistics did not load: {message}
errors.options: The completion options did not load: {message}

manualTime.label: The calculated review time is not accurate
manualTime.help: This will be shown in reports for context, but won't replace the calculated time.

runSummarize.label: Run summarize task
runSummarize.help: OpenCouncil summarizes the reviewed transcript and extracts the subjects of the meeting.

notifications.auto: Subscribers get a notification as soon as the summary is ready.
notifications.approval: Notifications wait for an administrator to approve them before they go out.
notifications.disabled: No notifications go out for this meeting.
notifications.beforeRelease: The meeting is not published. Subscribers get a notification for a page that they cannot open.

unavailable.succeeded: A summary already exists for this meeting.
unavailable.running: A summary is already in progress for this meeting.

explanation.title: How we calculate review time
explanation.description: This is an approximation based on edit timestamps and the audio duration between edits. We detect review sessions by analyzing time gaps that exceed the expected review time, helping distinguish active work from pauses.
